name: Sandbox Kingdoms

tracks.title: Sandbox Kingdoms - main theme
tracks.style_prompt: Cozy whimsical acoustic indie game music, peaceful and nostalgic, tabletop toy-box sand castle atmosphere, Acoustic Guitar, Marimba, Upright Bass, Drums, Glockenspiel, Flute, 92 BPM, memorable repeating melodic motif, instrumental, no vocals, dynamic game soundtrack score, seamless looping structure
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(sparse ambient layer, quiet pulse)
[Verse 1 - Exploration Layer]
(fingerpicked Acoustic Guitar, gentle Marimba melody)
[Pre-Chorus - Tension Build]
(soft Glockenspiel top-line, warm Upright Bass pulse)
[Chorus - Combat Layer]
(full cozy rhythm section, bouncing Upright Bass, upbeat brush Drums)
[Bridge - Danger / Boss State]
(slightly melancholic shift, minor chord Acoustic Guitar, solo Flute)
[Outro]
(resolution back to ambient loop tail)
tracks.notes: Exported 32-bar loop (bars 4-36, 10.43s-93.91s, 83.48s, 4006957 frames @ 48kHz 24-bit) via SonicAlchemist export-adaptive.exe with 0.85s fade-in/fade-out clip envelopes (seam_step <= 0.000002). Integrated into /Game/Audio/Music/SW_Music_*_v001 with 4 states (Explore, Tension, Combat, Boss).
